name: Extension Memory Isolation
description: Extensions get isolated memory banks. No cross-extension memory access without explicit capability grant. Each extension operates within its own private memory space.
purpose: Prevent information leakage and unauthorized access between extensions by enforcing strict memory isolation at the bank level, with capability-based sharing for legitimate cross-extension access.
acceptanceCriteria: Each extension has its own isolated memory bank
Extension A cannot read extension B's bank by default
Explicit capability grants allow cross-extension memory access
Isolation extends to all memory operations (read, write, recall, reflect)
rollback_strategy: Revert to default isolated banks; revoke all capability grants
recovery_strategy: Replay capability grant journal; restore bank ownership assignments
